She sits in shock, with fear visible on her face, as if she still cannot believe what has suddenly happened to her. The Nepal Army deserves immense appreciation for risking their own lives to save people trapped in these dangerous conditions. The devastation in Nepal is truly heartbreaking. Your child spends the summer holidays in Nepal with his grandparents… and comes back taller and slightly different. 😂🇳🇵 Not performed. Not forced. Just sitting on the floor, eating dhido with his hands and casually testing his chilli tolerance, even with the nose shuffles. 🌶️😭 And this is exactly why raising a multicultural child means more to us than simply telling him where he comes from. We want him to experience it. Live it. Spend time with family. Eat the food. Hear the language. And build his own relationship with every part of who he is. After a summer surrounded by family in Nepal, you can definitely tell his Nepali side has been activated. 😂🇳🇵 Anyone else’s child come back from visiting their grandparents with a whole new personality? 😂 #growingupglobal #nepaliculture #nepalifood #multiculturalfamily  #familytimetogether
